nothing_to_say.text: They give you a polite nod and carry on with their day.

memory_coach.text: Forty years a Keeper, me. I can't find my glasses, but I've never once forgotten a move.
Shall I jog a creature's memory? No charge, love.

then.text: There we are. Right back where they left it.

else.text: Righto. I'll be here with the crossword.

then.text: Today's forecast: wet. Brook and Tide moves hit harder in the rain, and a proper downpour damps Hearth right down. Pack a brolly and a water type.
Today's forecast: sunshine, mark the calendar. Hearth and Hedgerow moves are in their element, Brook goes a bit limp, and everyone lands more critical hits. Foes included, mind.
Today's forecast: fog. Every move's a bit less likely to land, so don't bet the farm on a wobbly one.
Today's forecast: a gale. Gale moves hit harder. Hold on to your hat, and your creatures.
Today's forecast: a hard frost. Frost moves bite harder and Hearth struggles to get going.

else.text: Today's forecast: clear as a bell. No help from the sky today, so it's all down to you.
